context:
MCP registration functions: use factory functions that close over data, returning the
inner handler. This is the same pattern as existing MCP tools in discovery.py
(already approved as ignore, but the factory approach is worth borrowing).

Analytics functions: three-phase pattern - load files, compute metric, format output.
Extract each phase. Avoid shared mutable state between phases.
description:
8 MCP tool and analytics functions mix phase logic (file enumeration, metric extraction,
aggregation, formatting) in single long functions. Extracting phases to private helpers
reduces complexity while keeping the MCP-registered tool function as a readable summary.

Target functions:
  benchbox/mcp/resources/registry.py:register_all_resources       (20)
  benchbox/mcp/tools/analytics.py:_get_performance_trends_impl    (20)
  benchbox/mcp/tools/analytics.py:_aggregate_results_impl         (18)
  benchbox/mcp/tools/analytics.py:_detect_regressions_impl        (17)
  benchbox/mcp/tools/analytics.py:get_query_plan                  (15)
  benchbox/mcp/prompts/registry.py:register_all_prompts           (15)
  benchbox/mcp/tools/benchmark.py:_run_benchmark_impl             (16)
  benchbox/mcp/tools/benchmark.py:_validate_config_impl           (15)

anti_patterns.dont: add async to sync functions or remove async from async functions
change the JSON response structure of any MCP tool or resource

anti_patterns.why: keep them separate (each serves a different MCP tool)
they're part of the public API

preserves.behavior: _detect_regressions_impl: regression detection logic and threshold comparison unchanged
_get_performance_trends_impl: trend values and structure must be numerically identical
_validate_config_impl: validation error messages must be identical (MCP clients may parse them)
register_all_prompts: all prompt names, descriptions, and argument specs unchanged
register_all_resources: all MCP resource URIs and JSON shapes must be identical

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/ -k 'mcp or analytics or benchmark_tool' -q

verifications.expected: No WARN entries for the 8 target functions

work_units.notes:
benchbox/mcp/resources/registry.py:34 - nested function definitions for
list_benchmarks, get_benchmark, list_platforms, get_platform each follow
identical fetch → JSON structure pattern. Extract resource factories:
- _make_list_resource(fetch_fn, formatter_fn) → Callable
- _make_get_resource(fetch_fn, formatter_fn) → Callable
Registration becomes: server.register_resource(uri, _make_list_resource(...))
work_units.summary: Decompose register_all_resources: extract per-resource handler factories
